title: [Control Systems] Moxa security advisory (AV26-742)
description: On July 24 2026, Moxa published security advisories to address vulnerabilities in the following products:
products: Moxa UC Series  multiple versions and models
Moxa V Series  multiple versions and models
Moxa VM-1220 Series  version MIL3 v1.1.0 and prior
Moxa ioThinx 4530 Series  version MIL3 v2.1 and prior
Moxa AIG Series  multiple versions and models
Moxa BXP Series  multiple versions and models
Moxa DRP-A100 Series / DRP-C100 Series  version Debian 11 V1.0
Moxa RKP Series  multiple versions and models
solution: Review the references and apply the necessary updates.
